mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 20-day SPX returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% or Rank IC for UNRATE (in those periods) is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 290) combined with elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals a monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 290 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5% or Rank IC for interaction (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) in those periods is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 290.0), a high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 295) signals an imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods in late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 290.0) with CPIAUCSL > 295 or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL (in those periods) is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS against 5-day SPX returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 or Rank IC for INDPRO (in those periods) is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in both housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and retail sales (RSAFS < 660000) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 660000 or Rank IC for interaction (HOUST * RSAFS) in those periods is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery (PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 4.0%), a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 3.8%) signals an imminent labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods in labor market recovery (PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 4.0%) with UNRATE > 3.8% or Rank IC for UNRATE (in those periods) is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
